presentation.rationale: The foundation package owns the projection-neutral execution runtime substrate (run identity, status, retry, dead-letter); observe blocks and operator views are separate projections that read it.

redistributedComplexity: a run identity, status vocabulary, transition table, retry rule and dead-letter path reinvented inside every engine that runs something (exchanges, workflows, plans, reports, projections)
retry parameters and exhaustion behaviour allowed to drift between engines instead of being one substrate rule an author selects a named profile from
